brand_dna.category: Natural skincare formulated specifically for kids and tweens aged 7 to 14, an in-between age group most brands skip.
brand_dna.core_belief: Skin changes way before 18 does. Kids are taught to brush their teeth and wash their bodies, but no one teaches them to care for the skin on their face - so they built skincare for that gap.

Free from parabens, sulphates, artificial fragrances and pesticides
Trusted by 40,000+ families and stocked in 130+ retailers across Australia, New Zealand and Noumea

brand_dna.positioning: Purpose-built, transparent, gentle premium care for a 7 to 14 age gap - not diluted adult formulas or watered-down kids products.

banned.claim: Treats or clears acne, eczema, or rosacea
banned.why: Implies a drug effect on a disease - cosmetics may only address appearance, not treat conditions.

banned.claim: Repairs or heals the skin barrier
banned.why: 'Repairs/heals' claims structure/function changes and makes it an unapproved drug; use 'supports' or 'helps skin feel balanced'.
Structure/function claim banned for cosmetics under the compliance rules.

banned.claim: Anti-aging or reverses aging on young skin
banned.why: Banned aging-reversal framing and off-brand for a 7-14 audience.

banned.claim: Clinically proven to reduce redness or breakouts
banned.why: No study is provided; 'clinically proven' cannot be used without one.

banned.claim: Cures sensitivity or eliminates breakouts permanently
banned.why: Curative/permanent claims imply a drug effect not permitted for cosmetics.
